description: This PHP source file defines a controller class 'AjaxDashboardController' within the Goteo project, responsible for handling AJAX requests related to dashboard operations such as fetching user projects, interests, project materials, handling matcher actions, and social commitments. It serves as an API endpoint for various dashboard functionalities.

classes.name: AjaxDashboardController
classes.description: Controller class handling AJAX requests for user interests, projects, project materials, matcher actions, social commitments, and SDG suggestions within the dashboard context.

methods.name: projectsInterestsAction
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to fetch projects based on user interests or popular projects if no interests are available. Also updates user interests if a POST request is made.

methods.name: projectsMineAction
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to fetch projects created by the current user.

methods.name: projectsInvestedAction
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to fetch projects the user has invested in.

methods.name: projectMaterialsTableAction
methods.description: Returns a view of project materials and rewards, with access control.

methods.name: joinMatcherAction
methods.description: Handles actions to accept, reject, activate, or discard matcher proposals for projects.

methods.name: odsSuggestionAction
methods.description: Returns SDG icons associated with a social commitment for social suggestions.

methods.name: sdgFootprintAction
methods.description: Provides a list of SDGs based on a specified footprint.
